description: Start here — frisian-mcp documentation and server guide. Actions: about (server identity and links), getting_started (step-by-step adoption guide), integrations (Django/DRF config reference), security (auth model, OAuth, API keys, tiers), demo (explore the live demo endpoints), documents (browse all documentation articles), rag (semantic and full-text doc search).

action.description: Operation to perform. Omit or use 'help' to list all available actions and their required parameters.

continuation_token.description: From a probe response. Send at the TOP LEVEL, not inside 'params'.

params.description: Action-specific parameters. about: {version}; getting_started: {version}; integrations: {version}; security: {version}; demo: {surface}; documents: {sub_action, slug, id, category, package, limit, offset}; rag: {query, limit, offset, category, package}. 'mode', 'page', 'page_size' and 'filter_keys' are top-level ONLY on a continuation call (i.e. alongside a 'continuation_token'); otherwise they are ordinary action parameters and belong here.

name: docs
